title_en: APARTMENT 2+1+2 FOR SALE IN UNIVERS CITY!
description_en: The apartment is located on the sixth residential floor of a building under construction, part of the Univers City complex. The palace is in the final stage of works and is expected to be delivered very soon. It has a total area of ​​90.92 meters and a net area of ​​79.89 meters. It is organized in: A distribution corridor Living room together with the kitchen, living room with access to the balcony Two bedrooms, one of which (the master bedroom) with an internal toilet Two toilets A balcony For more information, we invite you to contact us!
